name: heat_pump_vitocal_300g
title: Vitocal 300G brine-to-water heat pump (scroll compressor, two plate heat exchangers)
summary: Water-to-water R134a heat pump of the Vaillant Vitocal 300G type: scroll compressor by the Winandy et al. (2002) semi-empirical model or the ARI/Copeland catalogue polynomial, plate evaporator on 30 % ethylene-glycol brine (Thonon + Hsieh) and plate condenser on the water circuit (Thonon + Kuo), both sized from their area with pressure drops, pinch points and hold-up as outputs.
language_features: lookup tables read and written inside procedures
external lookup table by name (ZH38K4E-TFD, missing from the collection)
